sources.label: App-scoped Morphe patches built with the official Gradle template
sources.author: Pigfoot
patch_list: Optional parallel installation with a default or custom package name. Without this patch the original package is retained. The app name is unchanged; providers, permissions and links are isolated when selected.
Complete the observed bus-update rewarded unit using its loaded reward metadata; retain the original fallback. Requires sideload startup compatibility, not package renaming.
Required for supported re-signed standard or Shizuku installs, with or without package renaming. Bypasses the Java Play-license startup entry. Root mount is not qualified.
